annotations.title: TIA — import objects from a VCI workspace

description: Imports objects from the files of a VCI workspace into the project: it OVERWRITES each project object with its workspace file, and there is no undo. Only leaf objects are accepted: PLC blocks (OB, FB, FC, data blocks), PLC data types and tag tables; any other object (a container, a device, a PLC...) is refused with 409 vci_not_leaf before VCI is called, nothing changed. The object must already be mapped (409 not_mapped: export it first) and its file must exist (409 workspace_file_missing); 409 vci_mapping_outside_workspace: a mapping whose folder is not below the workspace root is refused before any write (details plc, kind, name, directory, root). An object whose status is already equal is skipped (action skip). The dryRun plan shows per object statusBefore and overwritesProjectChanges (true for projectChanged and conflict). expectedContentHash guards a block (hash from tia_export_block) or a type (tia_export_type), never a tag table (the schema refuses it); the serve verifies it in a dryRun too: a stale hash is 409 state_changed, a matching one returns the contentGuard receipt. After each import the serve runs a postcheck (status, consistency, compile errors, content hash) on the object it finds again by name, because an import REPLACES the project object: re-read it by name, not through a stale handle. A failed postcheck is 409 import_unverified: the project object WAS ALREADY WRITTEN and may differ from the file: review it with tia_export_block or restore it from the workspace, and never report the import as done. The batch is NOT a transaction: it stops at the first failure. 409 vci_batch_incomplete (details.done, failed, notAttempted) means the objects in done WERE written and the failed one may be partly written. 'Nothing was changed.' is promised only by refusals before the first write: any other failure (a first object's own error, 504 worker_restarted, a timeout, a lost connection) has an UNKNOWN or possibly partial outcome, so re-read with tia_vci_status before repeating. Run it with dryRun:true first (Gd11): the serve runs the same checks and lists what would be written, WITHOUT changing anything. Requires a connected project and a workspace root (409 workspace_unconfigured); 409 vci_inventory_incomplete (the workspace inventory could not be read completely), nothing changed. Maps to POST /vci/workspaces/{workspace}/import {objects, dryRun?}. Class M-off. Long operation: may answer status:"running" + jobId — then call tia_job_status.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

objects.description: 1 to 50 distinct objects to import; more than 50 is 400 batch_too_large and nothing runs

expectedContentHash.description: Stale-write guard (optional, blocks and types only; a tag table has no export hash and is refused): the `contentHash` of the object as you last read it, with tia_export_block for a block or tia_export_type (or tia_type_source) for a type; 64 hex characters. `contentHash`, `normalizedSha256` and `sha256` are different hash contracts over different normalizations: never substitute one for another, and pass only the `contentHash` of a fresh read as `expectedContentHash`. The serve verifies it while planning, so a dryRun checks it too: a hash that differs from the project object's CURRENT hash is 409 state_changed (nothing written), a match is confirmed by `contentGuard` in the object's result.

kind.description: block (OB, FB, FC or data block), type (a PLC data type) or tagtable (a PLC tag table): the only kinds VCI accepts

name.description: object name; the serve matches the exact name first, then ignoring case

plc.description: PLC name (from tia_plcs); omit for the first PLC of the project

workspace.description: workspace name, as listed by tia_vci_workspaces (the serve matches the exact name first, then ignoring case; a name that several workspace groups share is 409 workspace_ambiguous, details name and groups: never guessed, ask the human)

name: tia_vci_import
